posts.materialUpdate: Aldar officially named the first residential release at Marsa Al Saadiyat on 17 September: 351 villas; sales open 23 September 2026.
posts.body:
TALAY — FIRST VILLAS AT MARSA AL SAADIYAT

Aldar has announced 351 standalone 4–6 bedroom villas on Saadiyat Island. Sales open on 23 September 2026.

This is the first named residential release within the Marsa Al Saadiyat masterplan — a new opportunity for buyers following the island's next waterfront district.

Developer-confirmed starting prices, booking terms and handover were not included in the announcement checked.

posts.materialUpdate: Multiple brokers cite 14 September launch materials and open EOIs for Modon's Wadeem Gardens 4–6BR villas.
posts.body:
WADEEM GARDENS — HUDAYRIYAT ISLAND

Broker intelligence: Modon's new villa collection is being marketed with 4, 5 and 6 bedrooms across three gated clusters.

Brokers quote prices from AED 8.7 million and a refundable AED 50,000 EOI. Advertised terms include 25/75 payments, 5% on reservation and Q2 2031 handover, with financing subject to approval. These figures are not yet independently developer-confirmed.

A new family-villa option in Abu Dhabi's major island development programme.

Image: project marketing render.
